layout.body:
Subject: Photography class
Dear Mr. Clark,
Unfortunately, the photography class you registered for on October 20 has been rescheduled. It will now meet on October 28 at 6:00 P.M. instead of October 26 at 5:00 P.M. Your registration fee will be refunded if you have a scheduling conflict.
Regards,
Emily Rodriguez

questions.stem: When did Mr. Clark register for the class?
questions.analysis: When did Mr. Clark register for the class? 原文依据：the photography class you registered for on October 20 has been rescheduled 您在 10 月 20 日报的摄影课已改期 (A) On October 20 → 正确 (B) On October 25 → 错误 (C) On October 26 → 错误 (D) On October 29 → 错误

questions.stem: Why may Mr. Clark receive a refund?

options.A: If he registered for the wrong class
options.B: If he could not attend the class
options.C: If he was dissatisfied with the class

questions.analysis: Why may Mr. Clark receive a refund? 原文依据：Your registration fee will be refunded if you have a scheduling conflict. 如果您时间冲突无法参加，报名费将退还 (A) If he registered for the wrong class → 错误 (B) If he could not attend the class → 正确 (C) If he was dissatisfied with the class → 错误 (D) If he rescheduled the class → 错误
